title: Ivory Zari Silk Kaftan
subtitle: Ethereal Raw Silk with Antique Gold Zari
description: Flowing raw silk kaftan in pure ivory with shimmering antique gold tilla border and delicate pearl tassel neckline.
longDescription: Designed for effortless elegance, the Ivory Zari Silk Kaftan combines comfortable airy drapes with royal Pakistani formal aesthetics. The neckline features delicate handmade dabka and pearl tassels, bordered by an intricate antique gold zari hem.
material: Pure Korean Raw Silk with Zari Border
careInstructions: Do not spray perfume directly on embroidery
